component.name: CareerOS
component.summary: Career workspace for resumes, jobs, interviews, and applications

description.p: CareerOS is a desktop career workspace for managing job applications, resumes, interview preparation, coding practice, learning plans, and AI-assisted application workflows.
The Flatpak build uses the Flathub TeX Live extension for local LaTeX resume compilation, so users do not need to install a host LaTeX compiler.
Initial Flatpak packaging draft for CareerOS Desktop.
